payload.question: Look at this login page carefully. Which element reveals this is a phishing site?
payload.image_alt: A fake Google login page with subtle differences
options: The Google logo colors look slightly off
The password field asks for your current password
The page has a 'Sign in with Google' button
payload.anomaly_hint: Focus on the URL bar at the top of the browser

explanation: The domain is 'signin-verify.net', not 'google.com'. The 'accounts.google.com' part is a subdomain trick — the actual domain is everything after the last dot before the path. Attackers register lookalike domains and add legitimate-looking subdomains to fool users. Always read the URL from right to left: TLD → domain → subdomain.
